$orderId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id', 'customer', 'amount', 'status']) && (newData.child('status').val() === 'pending' || newData.child('status').val() === 'processing' || newData.child('status').val() === 'shipped' || newData.child('status').val() === 'delivered' || newData.child('status').val() === 'cancelled') && newData.child('amount').isNumber() && newData.child('amount').val() >= 0

$productId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'price', 'stock']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length > 0 && newData.child('name').val().length <= 200 && newData.child('price').isNumber() && newData.child('price').val() >= 0 && newData.child('stock').isNumber() && newData.child('stock').val() >= 0
